edge_labels: Default pi account administrator privileges on Raspberry Pi OS can provide or bypass authenticated access to RaspAP 2.5 web console, satisfying RaspAP's authenticated access precondition.
Administrator privileges on Raspberry Pi OS can disclose or modify piSignage credentials/configuration, satisfying authenticated low-privilege user access to piSignage before 2.6.4.
